entities.summary: Khalil-ur-Rehman Qamar is a Pakistani screenwriter, director, Urdu poet, lyricist and occasional actor and producer known for writing such dramas as Boota from Toba Tek Singh (1999), Pyarey Afzal (2013), Sadqay Tumhare (2014), the top-rated Meray Paas Tum Ho (2019–2020), as well as the 2019 film Kaaf Kangana.
